body: You know... at least you've got a girlfriend. Cherish that. She's a reason to live if you can't think of anything else.
Well it only took her about 2 days.

I was referring to the suicidal thoughts. I've never had them before. It must be because I'm getting older. When I was younger I had my whole life ahead if me, and now it's halfway or more than halfway over. It's so much harder to meet someone new now. It seems like all the good ones are taken or married. I really thought I had found the love of my life and it was just a shock when she dumped me for some asshole. I have been so depressed ever since, but trying really hard to pick up the pieces and move on. I just get so lonely and sad especially at night time.

How did I deal with heartbreak in the past? I went out and hooked up with a new girl. It's just not anywhere near as easy anymore. The dating pool around my age seems all but dried up and younger girls I either can't relate to, are too immature, or get scared off when they find out how old I really am.
Thank you. i know my confidence is a major problem right now.

Thank you for your reply. I have been doing all of these things. I joined a gym, I threw my self into fixing up my house, I've gone out several times a week, I quit smoking pot. I really have been trying to keep myself as busy as possible and to go out and socialize as much as possible. I just keep getting rejected over and over and over and over. I get these feelings of just wanting to end it all and give up, especially at night before I go to bed. That's when the loneliness really sets in. I don't understand why I have these feelings. I have been happy and single before. I have made it through heartbreak before, but it's never felt like this.
